raw: The details of that strange yet oh-so-real sight begin to warp and flow with Its silence, and everything is smeared with a thick layer of clouds.
content: The details of that strange yet oh-so-real sight begin to warp and flow with Its silence, and everything is smeared with a thick layer of clouds.

speaker: Andoain
content: No, no...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Andoain
content: I need to know more!

raw: [name="Lemuen"]Can you hear what I'm saying, Andoain?
speaker: Lemuen
content: Can you hear what I'm saying, Andoain?

speaker: Lemuen
content: Put that thing down...

raw: [name="Andoain"]No, Lemuen. You don't know what I saw. I can't stop here!
speaker: Andoain
content: No, Lemuen. You don't know what I saw. I can't stop here!

raw: Light bursts forth from Andoain's hand, like a plant rushing headlong into season, blooming as if about to wither.
content: Light bursts forth from Andoain's hand, like a plant rushing headlong into season, blooming as if about to wither.

raw: He wants to part the clouds. He wants to see the revelation in all clarity. He wants to grasp onto the possibility.
content: He wants to part the clouds. He wants to see the revelation in all clarity. He wants to grasp onto the possibility.

raw: From then on, once more did he set foot on a journey, bearing sin and evil upon his back. He guided foreign believers to Laterano, searching for an answer.
content: From then on, once more did he set foot on a journey, bearing sin and evil upon his back. He guided foreign believers to Laterano, searching for an answer.

raw: But he had no time to share what he saw, the truth that nearly shook him to his core.
content: But he had no time to share what he saw, the truth that nearly shook him to his core.

raw: He had walked so many paths, yet what was the one thing that remained constant?
content: He had walked so many paths, yet what was the one thing that remained constant?

raw: He will always remember that year, the year the salt wind buried his home, and the emotions he bore in his heart as he left Rocamarea—
content: He will always remember that year, the year the salt wind buried his home, and the emotions he bore in his heart as he left Rocamarea—

raw: That was the starting point of his journey.
content: That was the starting point of his journey.

raw: The sounds of the executor fighting the patrols do not stop. Andoain does not hold back as he casts his Arts, an endless font of light flowing from his body, winding its way into the depths of the maze.
content: The sounds of the executor fighting the patrols do not stop. Andoain does not hold back as he casts his Arts, an endless font of light flowing from his body, winding its way into the depths of the maze.

raw: Rather than a harsh light, it is gentle, perhaps even dim, like sunlight caressing a patch of autumn leaves, tracing the paths through which they fall.
content: Rather than a harsh light, it is gentle, perhaps even dim, like sunlight caressing a patch of autumn leaves, tracing the paths through which they fall.

raw: He asks himself: 'Pathfinder, where does this path end?'
content: He asks himself: 'Pathfinder, where does this path end?'
Until finally...

raw: A glaring red light cuts off his Arts.
content: A glaring red light cuts off his Arts.

raw: Once, he saw this alongside Yvangelista XI. Once, he found himself shaken...
content: Once, he saw this alongside Yvangelista XI. Once, he found himself shaken...

raw: The light is more icy, more piercing, more dangerous than before.
content: The light is more icy, more piercing, more dangerous than before.

raw: But Andoain does not close his eyes.
content: But Andoain does not close his eyes.

raw: He knows that cold machine is his Lord, his god, the foundation of his faith.
content: He knows that cold machine is his Lord, his god, the foundation of his faith.

raw: Andoain faces God. He does not turn away.
content: Andoain faces God. He does not turn away.

raw: He has sought and he has lost. He has pondered and he has doubted.
content: He has sought and he has lost. He has pondered and he has doubted.

raw: A sharp pain runs through him. It only takes a moment for his vision to go dark, but at the same time...
content: A sharp pain runs through him. It only takes a moment for his vision to go dark, but at the same time...
He hears God's answer.
